create_open_spiel_wrapper: create an OpenSpielWrapper instance wrapping a turn-based OpenSpiel RL environment for dm_env compatibility
reset_environment_episode: reset the OpenSpielWrapper environment to start a new episode and get initial observations
step_environment_action: step the OpenSpielWrapper environment with an action and receive the resulting timestep with rewards
get_observation_spec: get the observation specification returning an OLT NamedTuple with observation legal actions and terminal specs
get_action_spec: get the discrete action specification returning the number of distinct actions available in the game
